Emma (Finance): FYI HearthCare flagged invoice INV-2026-0402-1122 as overcharged. They say their committed plan (Team-50) wasnt applied and they were billed at Team-200 rates for Apr usage. Ticket SUP-4978. Asking for pro-rated refund + goodwill credit.

Raj (Support): Customer provided screenshots of billing page and plan confirmation email. I pulled the billing events: `events: [plan_change: 2026-03-28 plan=Team-50]` but invoice shows line items priced at Team-200.

Maya (Engineering): Checked the pricing service logs: 
```
2026-04-01T00:00:03Z pricing.assign plan_lookup failed for account=A-9912, fallback=default=Team-200
error: missing plan mapping for account tag: "commit-2026"
```
Root cause: plan lookup fallbacked to Team-200 for the billing run.

Billing Bot: Detected mismatch: expected plan Team-50 vs billed Team-200. Invoice total $5,320.00, expected $2,860.00 given commit. Suggested adjustment code ADJ-8467.

Diego (Sales): HearthCare is a strategic midmarket customer (~$65k ARR). Recommend pro-rated refund of the overcharge ($2,460) + $250 promo credit as goodwill. Also propose a non-recurring manual credit and ops follow-up.

Emma (Finance): Approving manual adjustment for $2,460 refund under ADJ-8467. Promo $250 OK as a one-time promotional credit. Please include a short memo: "plan misassignment refund + goodwill credit" and mark promo non-recurring.

Maya (Engineering): I'll create the adjustment PR and attach pricing logs. API call I'll make: `POST /internal/billing/adjustments {"invoice":"INV-2026-0402-1122","amount":-2460,"reason":"plan misassignment refund","code":"ADJ-8467","non_recurring":true}`. Also opening an issue in infra to add a fallback alert.

Raj (Support): Notified customer: "We're processing a $2,460 refund and applying a $250 promotional credit. Expect refund in 3-5 business days." Customer replied with :relieved:. Ticket SUP-4978 updated with ADJ-8467 reference.

Diego (Sales): I'll log the promo in CRM and loop in CSM to ensure churn risk low.

Billing Bot: Adjustment ADJ-8467 posted to ledger on 2026-04-03. Invoice INV-2026-0402-1122 updated; promo PROMO-HEARTH-250 applied to account. Notification email queued to customer."
